maddeler.e:
اصباححت (form XI)
# اِصْبَاحَحْتُ (iṣbāḥaḥtu) /isˤ.baː.ħaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# اِصْبَاحَحْتَ (iṣbāḥaḥta) /isˤ.baː.ħaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# اِصْبَاحَحْتِ (iṣbāḥaḥti) /isˤ.baː.ħaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
